name: TV TOKYO Holdings Corporation
summary: TV TOKYO Holdings Corporation operates as a broadcasting holding company in Japan. The company operates through Terrestrial BS Broadcasting Business, Anime/Distribution Business, and Shopping and Other Businesses segments. The company is involved in terrestrial and BS digital broadcasting; planning and production of musical compositions and programs, and animation programs; copyright management; planning and sale of packaged software; and preparation of commercial broadcast.
